## The Voice

This is a voice that has stopped arguing and started legislating. Across 292 judged spans, RHETORIC leads at 152 against only 51 SLOT_CLAIM and 7 EVIDENCE (role_distribution) — the paper spends more than twice as much time declaring as defining. The sentences are short and declarative, averaging 9.98 words (volume.sentence_len.avg), and they land like verdicts: "It is doing all the work." (idx 25). There is no hedging anywhere — hedge_to_absolute_ratio is 0.0 — so the tone is not persuasion but pronouncement, a canon reading its own rulings aloud.

## The Dominant Slot Signature

Alignment (g, 19 hits) and the multiplicative structure (m, 14) carry this paper; Time (t, 9), Entropy (e, 7), Resistance (r, 6), and Charge (c, 6) fill in behind them. The peak sentence is the thesis entire: "It is the arithmetic of the Trinity applied to creation's structure — and the structural consequence is the veto property, which says that any single zero colla" (idx 47, z 14.805). That is the product test stated as theology — multiplication as unity, zero as collapse. But the slot evidence is thin for a 5,111-word paper: 14 product-test spans and 3 MECHANISM spans across 512 sentences (product_test_span_count, role_distribution). The signature is real but sparse — a skeleton, not a body.

## The Canon Reading

The docket is lopsided: 7 CANON-READY, 92 HOLD, 31 NEEDS-RULING across 130 claims (verdict_counts). A HOLD is not a refutation — it is a claim waiting on a receipt, a grade not yet ruled. Nearly every HOLD here fails on receipt alone: M001 ("χ(X) is defined as CW[ ∏i=19 Xi ]"), M005 (the veto property), M019, M020 — the paper's own definitions and its central product claim are all waiting on documentation, not on truth. The NEEDS-RULING claims are the ones that need David, not the machine: M003 ("W is free will and η is grace") and M011 ("The framework does not carry four debts; it holds one axiom, God") both fail receipt and no_conflict — they are theological identifications that collide with something the ledger cannot adjudicate. The retirement watch is empty.

## Where the Gaps Are

The strain shows in the short declaratives that carry no slot weight: "It is doing all the work." (idx 25, score -2.0) and "The price of admission to thinking at all." (idx 69, score -2.0). These are rhetorical punches thrown where a receipt should stand. Effective Strength (s_eff) is the one empty slot at 0 hits (slot_axis.s_eff.total) — the paper never says what the equation does to a system, only what it is. The recurring canon flag is receipt_missing: 92 HOLDs and 31 NEEDS-RULINGs, almost all on that single condition. The no_conflict failures on M003, M011, and M013 are the ones to watch — claims of canonicity that assert theological identity with no ruling cited.

## The Takeaway

This is a canonical declaration wearing the clothes of a derivation — a text that states its rulings before it receipts them. Read it as a constitution, not a proof: the structure is coherent (9 of 10 slots filled, me.score 167.6), but the ledger is holding nearly everything for documentation. Hold the product-test claim (M005) firmly as the paper's spine; hold the theological identifications (M003, M011, M013) loosely until David rules. The cost of reading it well is resisting the voice's certainty long enough to notice what is still waiting on a receipt.
